_comment: Which deployable packages each catalogue agent offers. An agent not listed under 'agents' offers 'default'. Ids: copilot-studio = Copilot Studio connect package / managed solution; m365-copilot = Microsoft 365 Copilot package. Only list a package for an agent once that package exists and has been installation-tested. The agents page drawer, pay panel and generated factsheets read this; tests/product-release.test.mjs fails if the copy embedded in the pages drifts from this file.
